summary: Rung 3 of the PR ladder: two Claude Code hooks (PreToolUse blocks hand-edits to generated files -- CARD_INVENTORY.xlsx, content/published/*.json, the catalogue-art-pack/manifest -- via a real hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision:deny block plus exit 2; Stop reminds, never blocks, about a missing handoff for changed engine files, reusing collab.py's own branch/paths_changed/audit rather than reimplementing) plus tools/lint_comment_swallow.py, catching issue #498's real swallowed-comment bug shape and the ??/||/.Concat chain-before-comment risk shape, scoped to changed lines via a shallow-clone-safe two-tree diff (not merge-base, which a real dedicated test proves would silently no-op in a CI-shallow checkout), wired into tools/check.sh (~1s, batched into one git diff instead of ~475 per-file calls after an initial 43s version) and check.yml (a small extra fetch of main's tip).
validation: New tests: tools/hooks (20 passed, real subprocesses with crafted stdin), tools/test_lint_comment_swallow.py (16 passed, including a fixture reconstructing issue #498's actual historical bug and a genuinely shallow-clone test). python -m unittest discover -s tools/content -p test*.py: 135 passed, unchanged. python -m unittest discover -s tools/collaboration -p test_*.py: 55 passed, unchanged. bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: full green run (2453-line log, zero failures) after a first attempt was killed by unrelated system memory pressure and retried. python tools/collab.py audit --working: clean. No .NET/engine tests beyond check.sh's own existing coverage were needed since no engine behavior changed.
remaining: None; ready for review. Known limits stated in the PR: the comment-swallow lint's two heuristics have a documented false-positive/negative shape (see PR body); the Stop hook's reminder only fires for src/L5R.Core|AI|Server and content/, matching the task's literal list (not assets/ or other lanes); NotebookEdit is included in the PreToolUse matcher for completeness even though this project has no notebooks.
